te: Zelensky: Kiev coordinates with partners all foreign military operations
de: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Kiev coordinates with foreign partners military operations affecting the interests of other states. In an interview with the BBC, he reacted to the accusations of Libya and Italy in connection with the attack on the port of Benghazi.

de: The Russian government has zeroed export customs duties on peas, chickpeas and lentils until March 31, 2027. The decision is enshrined in the decrees of the Cabinet of Ministers of November 26.

de: At the end of November, the inhabitants of Russia will be able to observe the convergence of the moon, Jupiter and Mars. Together with them, a bright star Regulus will fall into a small part of the sky. In Moscow and in the south of the country, the phenomenon will be best seen on the morning of November 30, and in some cases, the phenomenon will be more visible…

d: 18-летняя актриса Ника Жукова призналась, что раньше ей было обидно, когда её успехи приписывали отцу, певцу Сергею Жукову. По словам дочери звезды, особенно тяжело было читать такие отзывы после того, как она долго готовилась к роли.

de: 18-year-old actress Nika Zhukova admitted that she was hurt when her success was attributed to her father, singer Sergey Zhukov. According to the daughter of the star, it was especially difficult to read such reviews after she had been preparing for the role for a long time.
